sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Before commencing route, quick standby due to emergency restroom break.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street reporting a male vagrant sleeping inside their lobby; requesting removal due to the customer-only policy for tables and chairs.

Arrived at response location, McDonald's Queen. Tapped the person of interest on the shoulder to wake him and advised him to leave due to complaints and customer policy. He complied without further issues.
Welfare check along 77 Convenience Store and Mid City shopping centre, all clear. Standby to show presence before moving along.
Continuing patrols due to no activities concerning our assistance.
Welfare check along Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Checked in at Aotea Square; full walkthrough, all clear. Standby for response calls and incidents.
Checked in at Elliott Street Apartment, all clear.
Overheard yelling and screaming coming from Queen Street.

Came across a male individual yelling and screaming walking up Queen Street. Stopped him and advised him to keep the volume to a minimum or be reported for disorderly behaviour. He acknowledged our request and moved along.
Welfare check inside Atrium on Elliott, making our way up towards Crowne Plaza Hotel, all clear.
Patrolling down Albert Street ensuring presence is visible.
Welfare check along Sky Mart Convenience Store, Formery and Little Albert's Coffee, all clear.
Welfare check along Barclay's Suites, Good To Go Supermarket and Hollywood Bakery, all clear.
Welfare check along Federal Square and The Cathedral Church, no issues found.
Welfare check along Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Checked in at corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Welfare check along Metro Woolworths and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Checked in at Commercial Bay; full walkthrough completed. Standby to show presence before moving along. Ending Alpha Route.
Checked in at Kiwibank; store closed but welfare check on other stores within the area, all clear.
Checked in at bottom of Fort Street; welfare checks on stores and businesses, all clear. Quick standby to show presence.
Checked in at Wilson's Carpark; full sweep completed, checked in on stores and static guards, all clear.
Patrolling up High Street with welfare checks on stores and businesses, all clear.
Checked in at Chancery Square; full sweep completed, no issues found.
Response call from Management reporting a male individual consuming a wine bottle in public. Requesting assistance to intervene.
Patrolling down Queen Street in search of the POI consuming alcohol. Unable to find him; a static guard advised the POI was last seen walking up Queen Street with a wine bottle.

Huge commotion in front of Imperial Lane — two male individuals who looked about to fight. Quickly ran over and intervened, got between them, separated the two and advised one to keep walking while the other stayed. Shortly after, a police officer returned with the same POI; we gave an update and advised the officer the POI was looking for trouble while the other was only waiting for the bus. The officer said he would wait around in case.
Continuing search for the POI consuming alcohol; one guard will stand by. Patrolling up Queen Street.

POI consuming alcohol located in front of Mid City shopping centre; advised him consuming alcohol in public is prohibited and to take it out of public view. Walked him up towards top of Mayoral Drive and instructed him to go to K Road and stop drinking in public or police would be notified. He complied and left towards K Road (posted to Auror).
Response call from Celine on Darby Street reporting the same group of vagrants smoking drug substances next to their store.
Arrived at response location; the group of vagrants had moved to the front of Darby Street sitting on the benches. Standby to show presence and ensure no vagrants are smoking drug substances.
Response call from Typo reporting a male individual shoving items into his pockets.
Arrived at response location; caught the POI walking out of the store and asked him to return any items taken without purchase. He complied and handed over the stolen item (posted to Auror).
Arrived at HQ; taking a quick break before continuing patrols.

Response call from Mecca reporting a female individual sitting out front on the benches blasting her music loudly. A staff member asked her to turn it down; the POI became aggressive and slurred profanity at her.
Arrived at response location; had a word with the female POI and asked her to move along and keep the music at a reasonable level. She complied and moved along.
Response call from Auckland Council Wardens reporting the same POI consuming alcohol had returned, in front of Queen Street Maccas.
Arrived at response location; POI not found. Council Wardens were visible and confirming via radio; we advised them the POI they were calling about was a different person.
Call back from Council Wardens confirming it was a false alarm. Continuing standby to show presence.
Response call from Canterbury Arcade reporting a female individual blasting music and consuming alcohol in front of their store. Requesting immediate assistance.

Arrived at response location; advised the vagrant that police would be notified if she continued to consume alcohol and cause a disturbance. She refused to comply and the situation escalated. Police notified (posted to Auror).

Police arrived at the scene; we gave an update. Prior to police walking over, the POI quickly packed her belongings and ran away. The officer said he would follow her and ensure she consumed no more alcohol, though nothing could be done about the loud volume.
Heading back to HQ to recharge the Ops Phone due to low battery.
Arrived at HQ; taking lunch break and standing by to recharge the Ops Phone.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street reporting the same POI who smashed their front glass in 2024 is currently sitting in front of their store; staff feel concerned due to past interactions.
Arrived at response location; asked the POI, known as Junior, to move along due to complaints. He complied quickly without escalation and moved along.
Arrived at HQ; preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

Commencing patrols heading down lower Queen St towards Commercial Bay with welfare checks on stores along the way.

Commercial Bay sweep complete, no issues.
Arrived at lower Albert St; welfare check:
Welfare check on stores above complete, all clear.
Arrived at St Patrick's Square Cathedral; commencing a full sweep.
Full sweep of St Patrick's Square Cathedral complete, no issues or problematic vagrants.
Arrived at corner of Albert St / Victoria St West; welfare check:

One report retrieved from Surf n Snow Backpackers regarding a regular male vagrant known for sitting outside their store, yelling at passers-by and consuming alcohol in public. No other issues reported by the other stores.
Arrived at Mayoral Drive check-in; welfare check Te Waihorotiu Train Station, no issues reported by station security.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a full sweep.
Aotea Square sweep complete, no issues.
No issues reported from either store.
Arrived at Auckland Library check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Lorne St check-in; commencing a full sweep down to corner of Victoria St East / Lorne St with welfare checks on stores.
Arrived at corner of Victoria St East / Lorne St; full sweep of Lorne St complete with welfare checks, no issues.
Arrived at Freyberg Square / Chancery Square check-in; welfare check, all clear:
Response call from Macpac Queen St regarding a male minor who stole from their store (black puffer vest). No visual on his direction of travel; advised staff we will keep an eye out while patrolling.
Arrived at Fort St check-in; welfare check:
Welfare checks on stores above complete, no issues. Heading over to Gore St check-in.
Arrived at Gore St check-in; welfare check:
Welfare checks on stores above complete, no issues reported.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; standing by, keeping presence known and on the lookout for the Macpac POI and any problematic issues or vagrants.
Continuing security presence at Commercial Bay.
Leaving standby area, no issues and no sighting of the Macpac POI; will upload male minor to Auror. Patrolling up Queen St.
Arrived at Imperial Lane; commencing a sweep.
Full sweep of Imperial Lane, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Pocket Park; standing by, maintaining presence for members of the public and businesses.
Continuing security presence at Pocket Park.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane; welfare check, all clear. Standing by maintaining visible presence:
Leaving standby area, no issues. Continuing patrols up Queen St.
Arrived at bottom of Victoria St East; continuing patrols up Queen St with welfare checks.
Arrived outside Avachi; standing by for nearby response calls and on the lookout for problematic issues or vagrants. Welfare check complete:
Continuing security presence for businesses, members of the public and any nearby response calls.
Leaving standby area, no issues and no response calls received. Heading back to HQ to commence floor checks.
Floor checks complete. Standing by at HQ charging ops phone due to low percentage and remaining vigilant for response calls.
No response calls received; continuing charging of ops phone.
Commencing patrols; welfare check, all clear:
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a full sweep.
Full sweep of Aotea Square complete, no issues.
Arrived at Mayoral Drive check-in; welfare check:
Welfare checks on stores above complete, all clear.

Response call from Queens Ferry about a male swinging a doll that is lit on fire at people; heading to response call. En route we came across a law enforcement officer on patrol and informed him about the individual.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane; located the male outside Tatty's alongside the law enforcement officer. Male apprehended and taken into custody; standing by in case of assistance needed.
Due to heavy rain, taking cover on Vulcan.
While on standby we noticed a male consuming alcohol in public; spoke to him and his alcohol was confiscated by law enforcement.
Male vagrant continued to follow us as we walked away; informed him to move along somewhere else, he complied, no issues.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Standing by maintaining presence and ensuring public safety.
No issues; departing standby area, heading back to HQ for 30-minute break.
Heard alarms going off on Queen St; assisting to location.
Arrived at Avachi, the location of the alarms; standing by in case assistance is needed.
Heading back to HQ for handover.
Afternoon shift concluded; handover to night shift.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone. All Auror reports processed.
